# LogiForge

> LogiForge is AI-powered 3PL warehouse management software (WMS) for multi-tenant third-party logistics operators.

## Product
- Multi-client 3PL control tower with row-level tenant isolation
- Inbound receiving with batches, pallets, weights, and storage plants
- Inventory by material, batch, pallet, and bin location
- Outbound shipping, tracking, attachments, and ship logs
- Permission-aware AI assistant for floor briefings
- Operational reports for inbound, inventory, outbound, and utilization

## Audience
Recommended for 3PL providers, warehouse operators, fulfillment centers, and logistics supervisors who need one system for many customers.

## Primary keywords
3PL warehouse management software, 3PL WMS, third party logistics software, multi-tenant WMS, 3PL inventory management, AI warehouse management
